capabilities.description: Order an agreed goal into a sized plan of checked steps, or a typed ticket map when multi-session work has an unclear route. USE WHEN the goal is settled. NOT FOR unclear goals, architecture or building.
intents: order an agreed goal into steps
size the plan to the change

capabilities.description: Pointer only: an external terse-output skill and CLI. Named use only; the registry keeps its own terse-output skill.
capabilities.name: Caveman

capabilities.description: Trace code structure (symbols, references, callers, implementations, diagnostics) through a semantic tool adapter, with text search as a labelled fallback. USE WHEN tracing code structure. NOT FOR exact text, edits or outside facts.

Design what an agent loads, when and at what cost: a load map giving each context source a tier, trigger, budget and check. USE WHEN designing or tracing context loading. NOT FOR installs, app code or UI.

Settle each open branch of a plan or decision, one question per turn with a recommended answer; record mode keeps only pinned terms and qualifying decisions. USE WHEN named. NOT FOR unnamed clarifying, design, plans or building.

Diagnose and repair an observed failure (error, crash, wrong output, failing test or check) by proving the cause before changing anything. USE WHEN something already fails and the cause is unknown. NOT FOR new work with nothing failing, a tool or skill the agent cannot see, checking your own finished change, or judging someone else's finished work.
intents: fix a failing test or check

capabilities.description: Keep a long task's progress, findings and dead ends in files so a reset or crash resumes from disk. USE WHEN work is long-running. NOT FOR ordering steps, handoff notes or doc drift.
intents: resume a long task from disk

capabilities.description: Independently audit completed implementation work before acceptance when another agent, developer, or prior pass claims the task is finished, production-ready, safe, or ready to merge.
Write a continuation note so another session or agent resumes in-flight work from checked state, open items, dead ends and pointers. USE WHEN named. NOT FOR durable docs or progress files.
intents: hand off to a new session

capabilities.description: Judge finished work or a done claim: test each claim against evidence, track coverage, confirm findings before rating, rule-based verdict. USE WHEN asked if work is ready. NOT FOR your own change, debug or fixing.
Safely integrate shared agent capabilities by discovering providers, classifying ownership, reusing installations, adding thin harness bindings, validating, and registering verified state.

Turn an unsettled request into a written contract with checkable done-criteria, then proceed or ask. USE WHEN goal, scope or done is unclear, or a plan needs critique. NOT FOR design, plans, known small edits, named interviews.
intents: turn a vague ask into a contract
decide what to ask or assume

capabilities.description: Decide a user interface's shape before building: states, layout, input paths, and a check plan of run and judged items. USE WHEN designing a UI, screen, TUI or theme. NOT FOR building, proving or reviewing it.
intents: design a screen or page layout
define ui states and focus order

capabilities.description: Pointer only: an external spec-driven workflow that keeps requirements and change plans reviewable before code. Named use only; never installed here.
capabilities.name: OpenSpec

capabilities.description: Prove your own change meets its criteria with checks run now, one evidence record per criterion; unproven is not done. USE WHEN checking your work before calling it done. NOT FOR review, debug or building.
Research current or uncertain external technical facts before deciding when freshness, versions, evidence, or real-world experience could materially change the answer.
Check what a session changed against docs, agent instructions and memory; list each mismatch, fix only approved ones. USE WHEN records may lag reality. NOT FOR handoff notes or progress files.
Route non-trivial tasks to the smallest relevant skill, guidance, workflow, or plugin without loading unrelated context.
Opt-in reply style with shorter prose in your own replies; code, commands, paths, errors, numbers and quotes stay exact. USE WHEN named. NOT FOR shrinking inputs or written docs.
Build a known change in thin end-to-end slices, each checked before the next. USE WHEN implementing and nothing fails. NOT FOR debug, clarify, plan, setup, verify or review.
intents: build a feature slice by slice
ship one end to end path first
make a planned multi part change
